::: {#def-interventional-npsem .theorem}
# Interventional NPSEM

An NPSEM $\mathcal{M}$ for which a subset of structural equations $\mathbf E$ have been replaced by intervention equations in intervention regime $\Gamma$. 


$$
\mathcal{M}^{(\Gamma)} =  \{f_V^{(\Gamma)}: V \in \mathbf V \}
$$


$$
f_V^{(\Gamma)} = \begin{cases}
  h_V & \text{if}  & V \in \mathbf E\\
  f_V & \text{otherwise}
\end{cases}
$$


:::
